name: c1-acceptance
description: The single-stream suite's prompts at one stream: every prompt once, greedily, with the speculative-decoding counters per draft position read before and after (model), then the single-stream closed loop (c1). With every draft verified, accepted / drafted at position k is the drafter's survival P(a >= k) on the text the release generates; temperature-0 text does not depend on the verification policy.
